landing.headline: New color for discovery, faithful to every datum
landing.tagline: Reimagine vector PDFs and SVGs from R, Python, Prism, or Illustrator while keeping every line and raw image intact.

landing.headline: Tidy messy tables, export native Excel and Word
landing.tagline: Inspect the raw grid first, reshape long-to-wide layouts, merge summary pairs, format P values safely, and download editable .xlsx or .docx files.
landing.dropTitle: Drop CSV, TSV, TXT, or XLSX here
landing.formats: CSV, TSV, TXT, Excel (.xlsx), or press Ctrl/⌘+V to paste · Up to 25 MB

landing.samplesHeading: Or inspect a public raw dataset
landing.sourceCredit: Raw data: {{provider}} ({{license}}) · Summary computed by build script
